title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
original_description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)

Language requirement: fluency in German or Spanish

Location: Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

Employment: 18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role: 

We're hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You'll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You'll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren't there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you'll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

Key Responsibilities:

New Business and Client Engagement

  • Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
  • Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
  • Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren't present, and know when and how to bring them in.
  • Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis

  • Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
  • Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
  • Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design

  • Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
  • Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
  • Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
  • Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling

  • Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
  • Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
  • Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
  • Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting

  • Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
  • Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

About You:

Essential

  • 10-15 years' experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
  • A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
  • Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
  • A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
  • Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
  • Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren't in the room.
  • Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable

  • Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
  • Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
  • Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
  • Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
  • Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
  • Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

Be Ambitious to succeed   

Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what's possible   

Be Inspirational to do groundbreaking work   

Be always learning and listening to understand   

Be Results-focused  to exceed expectations   

Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist across our community, clients and creations

title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
original_description:
Deep Tech Recruitment is partnering with a Speedinvest venture-backed European AI company building the modern software backbone for specialist pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers.

Its mission is to strengthen the resilience of essential European supply chains by helping manufacturers overcome skilled labour shortages, respond faster to disruption and reduce the operational risk created by ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and fragmented knowledge. The business is developing an AI-native operating environment that provides consistent data and intelligent workflows across order management, production planning, materials planning and procurement, while retaining the human oversight required in regulated industries.

The company

The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees.

The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software.

The role

As an early staff engineering hire, you will help shape the platform from its first production versions. This is a hands on full stack role with strong backend ownership. You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving.

Why consider it

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture.

The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints.

The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter.

The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP.

What you will do

  • Build end to end product features with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.

  • Design and evolve backend services, APIs and system architecture for complex operational workflows.

  • Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL, with attention to reliability, performance and auditability.

  • Develop multi step AI agent workflows with validation logic, evaluations, monitoring and human approval points.

  • Integrate with enterprise systems including ERPs, communication tools and document platforms through REST APIs and other interfaces.

  • Support cloud and on premises deployments, working directly with customer IT teams where required.

  • Build secure, traceable workflows suitable for regulated environments and contribute to audit readiness and compliance documentation.

  • Join customer conversations, understand real operating constraints and translate them into product and technical decisions.

  • Help establish the engineering culture, technical bar and practical ways of working for the team as it grows.

What AI native means here

The company uses external language models and coding agents to build and ship software faster. The role involves engineering reliable AI enabled workflows around those models. It does not involve training foundation models or conducting AI research. Strong software engineering judgement remains central, particularly around evaluation, failure modes, observability and human oversight.

What you bring

  • Around 3 to 5 or more years of experience building and operating production software.

  • Strong backend engineering skills with Node.js, API design and system architecture.

  • Solid PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling and query optimisation.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems.

  • The ability to work across the stack using JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js.

  • A hands on approach. You can reason about architecture and still write, test and ship production code.

  • Fluent English for technical collaboration and customer conversations.

  • The willingness to work with the team from the Berlin office five days a week.

Useful additional experience

  • Enterprise software or products built for regulated, high security environments.

  • LLM integrations using providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, including evaluation and monitoring.

  • ERP integrations such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Infor.

  • Cloud infrastructure, DevOps and connections to on premises or legacy systems.

  • German language skills for direct customer communication.

  • Strong product and UX instincts, or experience working with design systems.

How the team works

  • High ownership and direct access to the founding team.

  • Fast iteration informed by customer workflows and operational reality.

  • Clear expectations, practical decision making and space to shape how engineering is done.

  • A long term product build with the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team expands.

title: Principal Thermal-Mechanical Engineer-Munich, Germany
original_description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

Compensation: $110K – $140K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Sales Engineer
original_description:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

As Sales Engineer at Artificial, you'll be the technical backbone of our sales process across Germany and the wider DACH/EU specialty (re)insurance market. You'll partner closely with Account Executives from first technical conversation through to signed contract, translating the messy realities of underwriting, policy administration, and claims workflows into clear, compelling demonstrations of what our API-first platform can do.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Lead technical discovery calls with prospective carriers, MGAs, and brokers to understand their existing systems, data, and workflow pain points

  • Design and deliver tailored product demos and proofs of concept that showcase the specific benefits of Artificial’s product suite. to

  • Act as the bridge between prospects and Product - feeding real-world requirements back into the roadmap, as well as Forward-Deployed Engineering to support delivery.

  • Support a smooth handoff to the delivery team once a deal closes, so technical context isn't lost

  • Represent Artificial at industry events, webinars, and broker/carrier roundtables across the region

  • Work closely with both, the market facing team in the DACH area and the sales engineering team we are building across the globe

About you

  • Experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or solutions / consulting role, ideally within insurtech, fintech, or B2B SaaS sold to enterprise buyers

  • Comfortable working hands-on with a broad range of software development tooling (e.g. GitHub, REPL) — you can speak credibly to a developer and a Head of Underwriting in the same day

  • Experienced with AI coding tools, their benefits and how to use the safely

  • Exposure to specialty or commercial (re)insurance workflows (underwriting, policy admin, claims) is a strong plus, though not a hard requirement

  • Fluent in both German and English, given the focus on the DACH market - and our ambition to scale across continental Europe

  • Preferably based in Germany, comfortable working remotely with occasional travel to customers, partners, and conferences

  • A natural communicator who enjoys translating technical detail into business value — and vice versa

  • Energized by the pace and ambiguity of a London-based Series B startup, with a bias toward getting hands dirty rather than waiting for perfect process

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.


    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.


    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

title: Chemical Engineer (Solid Propellants)
original_description:
Chemical Engineer

We are looking for a Chemical Engineer to develop and improve the propellants and laboratory capability behind our solid rocket propulsion systems. You will combine practical laboratory work with engineering judgement, working on formulation, preparation, characterisation, incoming-material inspection, and the scale-up of propellant solutions from laboratory experiments to propulsion hardware.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, formulate, prepare, and improve solid propellants for different propulsion requirements.

  • Plan and conduct laboratory experiments, characterise materials, and document results clearly.

  • Work with propulsion engineers to connect formulation, processing, material properties, and motor performance.

  • Support incoming-goods inspection, supplier engagement, and the evaluation of specialist chemicals and raw materials.

  • Investigate unexpected results, non-conformances, processing issues, and material compatibility questions.

  • Improve laboratory procedures, equipment capability, data quality, safety, and the scale-up of successful formulations.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, polymer science, energetic materials, or a related field.

  • Hands-on laboratory or process-development experience for solid propellants.

  • Strong understanding of chemistry, materials behaviour, experimental design, and laboratory safety.

  • A careful and methodical approach to traceability, measurement quality, process control, and documentation.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to investigate unexpected results.

  • The ability to work collaboratively with propulsion, test, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.

Desirable experience

  • Solid rocket propellants, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, catalysts, or energetic materials.

  • Propellant characterisation, burn-rate measurement, thermal analysis, rheology, mechanical testing, ageing, or compatibility.

  • Scaling a formulation or laboratory process toward repeatable production.

  • Incoming-material inspection, chemical quality control, supplier qualification, or non-conformance investigation.

  • Hazardous chemicals, explosives, or regulated laboratory processes.

  • Laboratory data systems, statistical analysis, or Python-based data processing.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

title: Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer - Munich, Germany
original_description:
About Vinci

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating the transformative value of our software.

By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will utilize deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition—showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges. This includes both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. Additionally, you will serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team..

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions — either as a practitioner running simulations, or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI, Be part of a team that is actively redefining how the next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state of the art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

Compensation: €120K – €130K

  • • €120K – €130K

original_description:
Mission

Founded in 2024 by Lukas Zörner and Anil Can Baykal, Integral set out to redefine how accounting, taxation and payroll works for SMEs in Europe, starting with Germany. The company is backed by General Catalyst, Cherry Ventures, Puzzle Ventures and entrepreneurs across Europe.

As Senior Product Engineer, you will help us build trustworthy product experiences that solve real customer problems on payroll, tax and accounting. Own outcomes, not just output, balancing speed and craftsmanship to deliver value that compounds using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies.

 
 

What you'll do

  • Ship user-facing features end-to-end: ideation, technical design, implementation, testing, release, and iteration

  • Collaborate with Product and Design to turn complex requirements into elegant, scalable solutions

  • Improve the reliability, performance, and security of our payroll, accounting, and tax platforms

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality via thoughtful reviews, pairing, testing, and documentation

  • Instrument features with analytics and logging; measure impact and iterate quickly

  • Own critical product areas with a bias for high-impact improvements

  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term architectural investments

  • Drive simplicity: reduce cognitive load for users and developers alike

What makes it special

  • High ownership: you'll shape what we build and how we build it

  • Your engineering decisions directly influence user experience and business outcomes

  • Tight feedback loops with customers and internal stakeholders

  • Pragmatic pace: ship, learn, iterate, without sacrificing quality

 

Experience & Mindset

  • 5+ years in software engineering with significant product-building experience at a startup or high-growth company

  • Proven track record of owning features and services end-to-end and driving measurable customer impact

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and discovery; experienced collaborating closely with Product and Design

  • You turn constraints into focus, manage your own time, and leave codebases and teams better than you found them

  • You simplify complex systems, make good decisions reversible, and build comprehensible plans

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools like Cursor, Copilot, or Claude, and able to audit and test AI-generated code

Technical Skills

  • Strong in at least two of: TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python

  • Domain Driven Design: solid grasp of domain design and relationships

  • Testing: unit, integration, and end-to-end; CI/CD, feature flags, and rollout strategies

  • Observability: logs, metrics, traces; familiarity with SLOs and incident response

  • Security basics: authN/authZ, secrets management, threat modeling, secure coding practices

The process

1. Intro Call with our Talent Team
2. Deep dive Interview with our CTO & co-founder
3. On-site Coding Interview at our Berlin office with the engineering team
4. Founder Conversation with our CEO & co-founder

Our offer

  • Above-market salary

  • Direct line to the Founders: no filter, no queue, no committee

  • Total autonomy on what you build; we measure hours saved

  • The best tools, no questions asked: Claude Max, Cursor, OpenAI, whatever ships next week

  • Internal tools and resources purpose-built to support agentic AI development at scale, read about how we work at engineering.integral.de

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club membership, coupons (Sachbezüge) to over 200 partners or Deutschlandticket, your choice

  • Best equipment you need to succeed

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, right next to Mauerpark

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8pm

  • A team of 50+ (and growing!) ambitious, diverse people, 20%+ ex-founders learning and building together

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

(We are especially looking for candidates based in Berlin)

  • You take on your role in further developing and redesigning our interesting and diverse system.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
original_description:
Mission

Founded in 2024 by Lukas Zörner and Anil Can Baykal, Integral set out to redefine how accounting, taxation and payroll works for SMEs in Europe, starting with Germany. The company is backed by General Catalyst, Cherry Ventures, Puzzle Ventures and entrepreneurs across Europe.

As Senior DevOps Engineer, you will help us build trustworthy product experiences that solve real customer problems on payroll, tax and accounting. Own outcomes, not just output, balancing speed and craftsmanship to deliver value that compounds using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain our cloud infrastructure with a focus on reliability, scalability and security

  • Own our CI/CD pipelines end-to-end — from design to rollout and continuous improvement

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code practices across the engineering team

  • Collaborate closely with product and AI engineers to enable fast, safe and frequent deployments

  • Monitor system performance, lead incident response and run post-mortems to keep raising the bar

  • Instrument infrastructure with observability tooling — logs, metrics, traces — and act on what you see

  • Ensure security and compliance standards are met across all environments

  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term architectural investments

  • Drive simplicity: reduce complexity for developers and keep systems easy to reason about

  • High ownership: you'll have a real say in how we build and scale our infrastructure

  • Your decisions directly impact the reliability and performance of a platform used by thousands of SMEs across Europe

  • Tight feedback loops with engineers, founders and stakeholders

  • Pragmatic pace: ship, learn, iterate

 

Core responsibilities

Experience & Mindset

  • 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or Cloud Infrastructure roles, ideally at a startup or high-growth company

  • Proven track record of owning infrastructure end-to-end and driving measurable impact

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you take initiative, manage your own time, and leave systems and teams better than you found them

  • You turn complexity into simplicity, make good decisions reversible, and build plans others can follow

  • Comfortable leveraging AI coding tools such as Cursor, Copilot or Claude — and able to audit and validate AI-generated code

  • Experience in fast-scaling environments is a strong plus

  • German language skills are a strong plus

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP preferred)

  • Containerisation and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes

  • CI/CD tooling: GitHub Actions, CircleCI, ArgoCD or similar

  • Infrastructure-as-code: Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent

  • Observability: logs, metrics, traces; familiarity with SLOs and incident response

  • Security basics: authN/authZ, secrets management, threat modelling, secure coding practices

  • Familiarity with Python is a strong plus, our engineers work heavily with Python and Claude

The process

1. Intro Call with our Talent Team
2. Deep dive Interview with our CTO & co-founder
3. On-site Coding Interview at our Berlin office with the engineering team
4. Founder Conversation with our CEO & co-founder

Our offer

  • Above-market salary

  • Direct line to the Founders: no filter, no queue, no committee

  • Total autonomy on what you build; we measure hours saved

  • The best tools, no questions asked: Claude Max, Cursor, OpenAI, whatever ships next week

  • Internal tools and resources purpose-built to support agentic AI development at scale, read about how we work at engineering.integral.de

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club membership, coupons (Sachbezüge) to over 200 partners or Deutschlandticket, your choice

  • Best equipment for you to succeed

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, right next to Mauerpark

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8pm

  • A team of 50+ (and growing!) ambitious, diverse people, 20%+ ex-founders learning and building together

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

title: Staff Engineer (m/f/d)
original_description:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview

Do you think in systems and lead by doing? At Solactive, we are looking for a Staff Engineer to drive the technical direction and architectural evolution of our Index Setup platform, building scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions. If you thrive on leading complex initiatives and shaping engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Tasks

  • Own the technical direction and architectural evolution of the domain, delivering scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions for index management and future platform capabilities.
  • Lead complex initiatives end-to-end: clarify ambiguous requirements, shape solution approaches, and drive implementation across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, including code and design reviews, coaching, and a strong focus on simplicity, quality, and maintainability.
  • Partner with product, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify core problems, challenge assumptions, and deliver solutions aligned with the platform vision.
  • Drive system design across distributed services, APIs, integrations, data models, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness.
  • Improve engineering effectiveness by refining processes, reducing friction, strengthening ownership, and enabling better trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk.
  • Mentor engineers and support their growth in technical depth, ownership, and end-to-end delivery.

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on software engineering background (7+ years) with deep expertise in Java and Spring-based backend development in distributed systems.
  • Experience with React / TypeScript frontend development in product teams owning full-stack delivery.
  • Strong system design skills, including service decomposition, API design, integration patterns, data modeling, scalability, reliability, and operational concerns in cloud-native environments.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous, business-heavy problem spaces: identify real requirements and root problems, structure chaos, and translate needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Proven track record of simplifying complex systems and delivering maintainable end-to-end solutions with high business impact.
  • Strong experience with modern engineering practices: code reviews, design reviews, CI/CD, testing strategy, observability, incident response, and production ownership.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Product mindset and delivery orientation: balances technical quality with business value and drives initiatives to completion.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
  • Modern Culture: Enjoy our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture.
  • Responsibility & Connections: Take over responsibility from day one and build relationships in- and outside of the company.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days, plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year.
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package.
  • Special Benefits: Job ticket, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space with ergonomic set-up, employee lounge, and free beverages and fruits.
  • Community & Networking: Engage in our various networking events.
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offers.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment.

title: Engineering Lead
original_description:
Mission

Founded in 2024 by Lukas Zörner and Anil Can Baykal, Integral set out to redefine how accounting, taxation and payroll works for SMEs in Europe, starting with Germany. The company is backed by General Catalyst, Cherry Ventures, Puzzle Ventures and entrepreneurs across Europe.

As our Engineering Lead, you will help define our tech stack and shape our engineering culture. This role involves frequent context switching across multiple domains, technologies, and business problems. In a given week, you may move between infrastructure, backend systems, integrations, AI initiatives, frontend work, and discussions with product stakeholders.
Success in this role requires comfort with ambiguity, strong prioritization skills, and a willingness to take ownership from problem definition through production deployment and ongoing support.
You will work alongside experienced engineers in a small, high-impact team that takes pride in crafting quality solutions and learning together. This role is onsite at our Berlin office.

Core responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy across the entire technology stack: from backend services and infrastructure to frontend development; build, test, and ship solutions based on evolving business requirements without sacrificing quality

  • Take end-to-end ownership of architectural decisions from initial design through to implementation; collaborate with the senior team to refine solutions and ensure they meet real business objectives

  • Maintain detailed documentation of technical decisions, processes, and system architecture; foster transparency and continuity by sharing insights clearly and consistently across the team

  • Work directly with the founding engineering team on the core platform that powers Integral's accounting, payroll, and tax services for thousands of SMEs across Germany.

What makes this role special

  • You are joining a small, senior team where your decisions shape the architecture, not just a ticket in a backlog

  • Direct collaboration with the CTO & Co-Founder from day one

  • High ownership: you ship, you learn, you improve

  • Your work has immediate, visible impact on a product used by SME founders who rely on Integral for their financial operations

  • The engineering culture is yours to help define.

Your profile

Your Experience & Mindset

  • 8 to 10+ years of professional experience in software engineering with a strong track record of building and shipping in startup or scaleup environments

  • Experience across multiple companies and environments; you have seen different architecture patterns, made the mistakes, and know what actually works

  • Staff, Principal, or Senior Engineer background where building and owning was the main focus, not coordinating or managing

  • Proficiency across a broad technical background with a strong foundation in system design and architecture

  • Strong command of at least two of the following: Java/Kotlin, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/React Native, Python

  • Expertise in architectural decision-making: you can design systems that balance complexity with long-term maintainability

  • Autonomous and pragmatic: you frame problems independently, design solutions, and execute without needing extensive support from other teams

  • Strong written communication: you write detailed technical documentation and decision rationale as a default, not an afterthought

  • Focused execution: you thrive in a hands-on role and are energised by practical outcomes, not by building a team around you.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience building in regulated or compliance-heavy domains

  • Familiarity with German accounting, payroll, or tax systems is a plus but not required

  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI capabilities into production systems.

The process

We move fast. With the right candidate, the full process takes less than 10 days.

1. Intro call with our Talent Acquisition Lead
2. Technical deep-dive with our CTO and founding engineering team
3. On-site in Berlin: meet the team and work through a real engineering problem together
4. Reference call

Our offer

  • Above-market salary

  • Direct line to the Founders — no filter, no queue, no committee

  • Total autonomy on what you build; we measure hours saved

  • The best tools, no questions asked: Claude Max, Cursor, OpenAI, whatever ships next week

title: Applied AI Engineer
original_description:
Nexxa.ai is building artificial super intelligence for heavy industries — enabling machines, systems and operations to think, decide and act autonomously across manufacturing, large-scale infrastructure, logistics and legacy environments.
Our mission is to translate deep technical breakthroughs into operational reality, solving some of the hardest systems-level problems in industry.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a Applied AI Engineers to work as forward deployed directly with customers to lead the end-to-end delivery of high-impact technical solutions. You’ll embed deeply with customer teams, translating real-world challenges into production-ready systems that leverage Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.

This role is a blend of software engineering, ML engineering, architecture, and consulting. You’ll design and deploy solutions, integrate models, build custom workflows, and guide customers through successful implementation. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage directly with enterprise and strategic customers to understand their workflows, data, and technical requirements.

  • Architect, build, and deploy custom solutions leveraging GenAI, LLMs, Machine Learning and Vision models, and customer data sources.

  • Lead full project lifecycles: scoping, solution design, development, implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.

  • Integrate and optimize AI/ML pipelines, including data preprocessing, prompt engineering, model selection, and evaluation.

  • Build reliable, scalable software integrations using APIs, cloud services, and containerized systems.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues across the stack—applications, models, data pipelines, infrastructure, and integrations.

  • Act as the customer’s trusted technical advisor, enabling adoption of new product capabilities and AI features.

  • Partner closely with internal product and engineering teams to communicate customer feedback and shape roadmap direction.

  • Produce high-quality documentation, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and technical assets for customer teams.

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal best practices for FDE delivery.

Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years in engineering roles such as Forward Deployed Engineer, ML Engineer, Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or similar.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or similar production-oriented languages.

  • Hands-on experience with Machine Learning, including training, fine-tuning, evaluating, or deploying models.

  • Direct experience with Generative AI (LLMs, multimodal models) and applying them to real-world problems.

  • Exposure to Computer Vision techniques (detection, segmentation, OCR, embeddings, multimodal pipelines).

  • Strong knowledge of ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, etc.).

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Comfort leading customer-facing engagements and guiding stakeholders through ambiguity.

  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently.

Preferred

  • Prior experience in consulting, technical solutions, professional services, or customer-embedded technical roles.

  • Experience with vector databases, embedding pipelines, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

  • Experience building APIs, microservices, or distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with MLOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, model registries, CI/CD for ML).

  • Background in deploying or fine-tuning CV models (YOLO, SAM, CLIP, DETR, etc.).

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments.

What We’re Looking For

  • A customer-obsessed senior engineer who thrives in deeply technical, fast-moving environments.

  • A creative problem solver who can translate vague requirements into robust, scalable solutions.

  • Someone excited to combine software engineering with real-world AI deployments.

  • A leader who can own outcomes end-to-end and influence both customer and internal teams.

    Why Join Nexxa.AI?

    • Innovative Environment: Play a critical role in transforming heavy industries through groundbreaking AI and automation technologies.

    • Collaborative Culture: Be part of a team that values innovation, discipline, and continuous improvement.

    • Professional Growth: Benefit from significant opportunities for career development and advancement.

    • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive salary and equity package reflective of your expertise and contributions.

    If you're passionate about development and eager to shape the infrastructure powering advanced AI solutions, we'd love to connect.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
original_description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As a Senior Member of Technical Staff, Machine Learning, you are an independent owner of critical ML subsystems in production. You take ambiguous problems, design practical solutions, and ship systems that operate reliably at scale.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role focused on depth.

 

Focus

  • Build core ML systems that power a proactive, long-horizon AI product.

  • Own work end-to-end: data preparation, training, evaluation, inference, and iteration.

  • Turn research ideas into working systems that run reliably in production.

  • Debug model failures and system issues using real production signals.

  • Iterate quickly: ship, measure outcomes, refine, and repeat.

  • Collaborate closely with research, product, and engineering to deliver real user impact.

  • Mentor and review work from other ML engineers through example and technical judgment.

  • Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety

 

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference systems

 

Ideal Experience

  • You have built and shipped ML systems used by real users.

  • You understand how modern ML models behave — and misbehave — in production.

  • You write strong, production-quality code and think in systems, not scripts.

  • You take ownership, work independently, and push work across the finish line.

  • You learn fast, communicate clearly, and improve through iteration.

 

Outcomes

  • ML models and systems in production consistently meet accuracy, latency, reliability, and efficiency targets.

  • Complex production issues are monitored, debugged, and resolved with minimal disruption.

  • Training, inference, and data pipelines are robust, scalable, and maintainable over time.

  • Drives measurable improvements in ML systems based on real-world signals and user feedback.

  • Provides mentorship and technical guidance to peers, raising the overall ML engineering standard.

  • Collaborates cross-functionally to ensure ML features integrate seamlessly into products and meet business goals.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) Data Science & Machine Learning
original_description:
Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) Data Science & Machine Learning

Bei unserem namhaften Kunden im Raum Aalen/Oberkochen - einem führenden Unternehmen der Hightechindustrie - bietet sich diese einmalige Perspektive im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit der Option auf Übernahme.

Dein zukünftiger Tätigkeitsbereich

  • Entwicklung und Industrialisierung von Algorithmen und Machine-Learning-Verfahren zur Auswertung optischer Messdaten

  • Mitwirkung beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung von Data-Science-Plattformen für die Messtechnikentwicklung

  • Konzeption, Implementierung und Pflege modularer Auswertesoftware sowie wiederverwendbarer Analysekomponenten

  • Überführung von Prototypen und Machbarkeitsstudien in robuste, testbare und wartbare Softwarelösungen

  • Analyse komplexer Messdaten und Ableitung datenbasierter Verbesserungen für Messverfahren, Modelle und Systemperformance

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Expertinnen und Experten aus optischer Physik, Messtechnik, Software- und Systementwicklung

  • Hands-on-Erprobung, Validierung und Optimierung von Algorithmen und Software direkt an Messmaschinen

  • Präsentation von Ergebnissen sowie verständliche Dokumentation von Methoden, Annahmen und Softwarekomponenten

Das zeichnet Dich aus 

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Informatik (m/w/d), Data Science, Physik, Mathematik oder vergleichbar

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Programmierung und Softwareentwicklung, vorzugsweise mit Python, sowie in der strukturierten Verarbeitung und Analyse wissenschaftlich-technischer Daten

  • Berufserfahrung in Data Science, Machine Learning oder Algorithm Engineering sowie Erfahrung bei der Überführung analytischer Ansätze in belastbare Software

  • Physikalischer Hintergrund oder Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung physikalischer Fragestellungen, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Optik, Messtechnik, Signal- oder Bildverarbeitung

Deine berufliche Zukunft

  • Vergütung: Übertarifliche Bezahlung zuzüglich Branchenzuschläge

  • Work-Life-Balance: Uns ist die Vereinbarkeit von Job und Familie sehr wichtig, daher sind 30 Tage Urlaub und ein Gleitzeitkonto selbstverständlich

  • Karriere bei Top Unternehmen: Freue dich auf langfristige Einsätze bei renommierten Unternehmen der Region mit echter Übernahmeoption!

  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Profitiere von betrieblichen Zusatzleistungen wie Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld, bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge und VWL

  • Wachsendes Unternehmen: Mit starkem Auftragseingang und Dynamik

  • Firmenveranstaltungen: Freu Dich auf das traditionelle jährliche encontec-Standortfest  

  • Persönliche Betreuung: Dein persönlicher Ansprechpartner steht Dir jederzeit zur Seite und kümmert sich um all Deine Anliegen

Stellendetails

Arbeitsort: Oberkochen  
Arbeitszeit: 40-Stunden-Woche

Vertragsart: Arbeitnehmerüberlassung

Dauer: 24 Monate

Startdatum: sofort oder nach Absprache

title: Senior Software Developer
original_description:
Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry; we are committed to turning the world from combustion to electric. We design, build, and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus, and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background, and approaches, and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars. Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!
 
To reach our goal, we are looking for a Senior Software Developer to join our Applications Team.  At Qwello, you will architect, design, and implement new backend services (typically in Rust and Python) to support our growing fleet of self-designed/built charging stations being deployed across Europe. You will also design and implement backend-to-backend systems connecting the Qwello systems with the services of Qwello's partners. Reliability and craftsmanship are important to you, so you design with automatic testability, resilience, introspection & observability in mind. Security is important to you. You are an efficient engineer, focused on the fast execution of your craft. You are a good communicator, a free thinker, have an inquisitive mindset, and an eye for detail. You enjoy sharing your knowledge with your colleagues and mentoring junior team members. You are comfortable working in a startup, collaborating in an interdisciplinary team, and willing to contribute, with your skills, experience, and enthusiasm, to help us build a successful business. As a proactive and committed team member, we continuously motivate you to continue learning and developing your skills.
 

Let's power the future together! ⚡


Your Responsibilities 🚀
  • Design and implement new web applications and serverless code in Rust and Python
  • Drive the transformation of our system architecture to meet our business needs and scale to our goals
  • Take part in strategic and execution planning, code reviews, design reviews, and hiring
  • Maintain and improve the Qwello backend as part of the Applications team
  • Work in close collaboration with our partners to integrate our services with theirs
  • Take ownership, along with the rest of the team, for building and refining our service as the business expands

    • Your Profile ✨
  • Proven experience as a Software Engineer implementing complex, larger projects
  • Expert-level Python implementation skills
  • Experience with Rust as a development language would be a big plus; the willingness to learn it is a must
  • Solid experience with architecting & implementing distributed systems
  • Hands-on off-premise cloud experience, preferably AWS, but Azure, Google Cloud, or similar via laC (Terraform) is also great
  • A make-it-happen attitude, helping the team to deliver on changing the world from combustion to electric
  • Ability to self-organize and lead in an environment of changing priorities; willingness to work on multiple tasks/content switching
  • Fluency in English; German language knowledge is a nice-to-have
    •  

    Your Benefits 🪴
  • Flat hierarchies with an efficient decision-making processes without red tape
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution
  • Be a part of an international dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid setup — choose how you want to split your time between our Munich office and working from home, with the possibility of workation within the EU, plus 30 vacation days
  • Regular company and team events outside of the office to disconnect from our computers and reconnect with colleagues on hikes, mountain e-bike tours, off-sites, and more
  • Personal and professional development through in-house lunch & learn sessions, collaborative discussions, as well as externally provided training, courses, and conferences
  • Discounted access to Wellpass for comprehensive wellbeing support—enjoy fitness, wellness, and mindfulness options to help you stay balanced and energized
    • Equal Opportunities:
    We strive to eliminate discrimination,  remove barriers and ensure equal opportunity through a transparent recruitment process. We are fully committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful work environment where everyone can succeed.  At Qwello everyone is welcomed regardless of cultural background, creed, race, sexual orientation, color or  gender expression.

title: InnoMaster Big Data Engineering - part-time Master's Program
original_description:
Part-time Master's Program starting April 2027
 
Do you have a passion for Big Data? Do you want to make your Master studies exciting and practical? Do you wish to continue studying after your Bachelor's degree while simultaneously stepping into the professional world? And all this with a fixed monthly salary and complete coverage of tuition fees? Then, our InnoMaster Program is just right for you!
 
As part of the InnoMaster Big Data Engineering Program, you'll typically study alongside your job at a university offering an accredited part-time Master's program in IT/Data Engineering located in Hamburg or its surroundings (e.g. FH Wedel), and we'll cover the costs for you! Concurrently, you'll gain valuable practical work experience working within various Big Data environments such as Google Cloud and on-site Hadoop, allowing you to apply your theoretical knowledge directly into practice! Support our Data Engineers and Data Scientists in processing, managing, and analyzing our data. In addition to responsible tasks and appropriate compensation, we offer participation in training sessions (related to the field, programming languages, or soft skills) and support in further career development.
 
The InnoMaster Big Data Engineering program is designed for approximately three years, with a weekly workload of 25-40 hours depending on your university schedule. We are happy to assist if you have further questions regarding the program.
 

Your skill set
  • Bachelor degree. You have completed your IT-related bachelor's or diploma studies with good grades (GPA of 2.5 or better).
  • Admission requirements. You meet the admission requirements of your preferred IT or data-related program at a university in the Hamburg area.
  • Data engineering. Your personal software projects reflect your affinity for software development and data engineering.
  • Big Data. You have an interest in Big Data ecosystems, some experience with Java and Python is a plus.
  • Soft skills. You enjoy working independently with a strong team-oriented mentality; demonstrate a high level of self-initiative and quick comprehension.
  • English as our company language. You look forward to using your excellent English skills in both spoken and written form daily.

    • Your power-ups
  • Team of specialists. Be part of a stable, growing, and award-winning global company. Meet your future colleagues in Development & IT in this video.
  • Perfect learning environment. We offer you an extremely interesting technical environment and state-of-the-art working conditions.
  • Career development. We support your professional and personal development with optimal guidance from a contact person in the department and from People & Culture.
  • Monthly salary plus education costs. We finance your full tuition fees, including books, plus a monthly salary of € 2.531,- gross per month.
  • Outstanding equipment. You work with a fully equipped MacBook Pro, and we provide you with a smartphone or tablet of your choice.
  • Agile work. You can expect flexible working hours and agile, cross-functional teams with short decision-making paths.
  • Team events. Participate in regular team events (e.g., wine tasting, cooking, paintball), barbecue together on our rooftop terrace, and enjoy regular company-get-togethers.
  • Comfy and modern office. We offer you various possibilities to combine work and well-being: fresh fruit and complimentary drinks, in-house fitness studio, gaming area, rooftop terrace with BBQ, relaxing rooms, and much more.
    • InnoGames is one of the leading German developers and publishers of mobile and browser games and a certified Great Place to Work®. The Hamburg-based company was founded in 2007 and is now part of Modern Times Group (MTG). Together with about 350 employees from 40 nations, the company founders develop unique games that provide many years of fun for millions of players around the world. InnoGames is best known for Forge of Empires, Elvenar and Tribal Wars, but the company is continually expanding its now 10-game portfolio across platforms and genres. Most recently, InnoGames launched Heroes of History, a novel mix of city builder and hero collection RPG and Cozy Coast, a feel-good beach adventure with elaborate merge-2-gameplay and a captivating story
     
    Excited to start your journey with InnoGames and join our team? We look forward to receiving your application (cover letter, resume, certificates, and code samples) exclusively as an online application via innogames.com/career. Your contact person is Saara Harris.

title: Senior Microsoft Infrastructure Engineer (m/w/d)
original_description:
Wir unterstützen Unternehmen bei der Planung, dem Betrieb und der Modernisierung ihrer Microsoft-Infrastrukturen. Von Active Directory über Endpoint Management bis hin zu Microsoft 365 und Azure betreuen wir komplexe hybride IT-Landschaften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Microsoft-Spezialisten, der moderne On-Premise- und Cloud-Technologien sicher beherrscht und gemeinsam mit uns die IT unserer Kunden weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

  • Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft-Infrastrukturen
  • Betrieb von Active Directory, DNS, DHCP und Gruppenrichtlinien
  • Verwaltung von Microsoft 365 und Azure-Diensten
  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft Intune und SCCM
  • Administration von Windows Server- und Windows Client-Systemen
  • Umsetzung von Security- und Compliance-Anforderungen
  • Verwaltung von Benutzer-, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten
  • Betreuung von Endpoint-Management- und Modern-Workplace-Lösungen
  • Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen
  • Mitarbeit in Kundenprojekten, Migrations- und Transformationsvorhaben
  • Gelegentliche Einsätze beim Kunden vor Ort oder im Rechenzentrum

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Microsoft-Infrastrukturen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Active Directory, Windows Server und Windows Clients
  • Erfahrung mit SCCM und/oder Microsoft Intune
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365 und Azure
  • Erfahrung mit Gruppenrichtlinien, Patchmanagement und Endpoint Management
  • Idealerweise Know-how in den Bereichen Microsoft Defender, Hyper-V, Monitoring oder Automatisierung mit PowerShell
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Führerschein Klasse B

Benefits

title: Cybersecurity Intern
original_description:
Cybersecurity Intern

Company: Sereact GmbH
Location: Stuttgart, Germany

About the role

Help us improve the security and monitoring of our cloud infrastructure and internal systems. A key project will be building and rolling out our SIEM platform for centralized security monitoring and threat detection. You’ll also work on vulnerability management and ISO 27001/SOC 2 controls, while developing security tools and automation using Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

You’ll receive technical guidance and gradually take ownership of practical security projects.

Responsibilities

  • Help build, deploy, and maintain our SIEM platform, integrating logs from cloud infrastructure, applications, identity systems, and network devices.

  • Configure monitoring dashboards, detection rules, and alerts to monitor infrastructure health and security.

  • Improve infrastructure security through access reviews, secure configurations, and vulnerability remediation.

  • Investigate alerts and support incident response.

  • Develop and maintain security automation and integrate checks into CI/CD workflows.

  • Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, audit evidence collection, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Pursuing a degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Basic knowledge of infrastructure security, networking, Linux, and SIEM concepts.

  • Familiarity with ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

  • Practical coding experience with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, plus familiarity with Git.

  • Curiosity, clear communication, and a practical approach to problem-solving.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.

  • Exposure to SIEM, monitoring, vulnerability scanning, or compliance tools such as Vanta.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Google Cloud Build.

  • Experience with REST APIs.

You don’t need experience with every technology listed. We’re looking for curiosity, a willingness to learn, and a practical approach to solving problems.

Our Interview Plan

  • Recruiter screen: Discuss your background, interests, and availability.

  • Technical screen: Explore your technical knowledge and problem-solving approach.

  • Final round: Meet the team leadership and learn more about the role and working environment.

What We Offer

  • Wellpass gym membership

  • Flexible working hours

  • Option to work from home when needed

  • A motivated team and an open corporate culture

  • Hands-on security experience in an AI robotics environment

  • Mentorship and learning opportunities within a fast-paced startup

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
original_description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

That takes high standards, high velocity and engineers who own what they ship.

Today, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management. At that scale, frontend performance, correctness and clarity are part of the product.

Our frontend platform spans web and mobile: TypeScript, React, React Native and React Native Web in an Nx and pnpm monorepo, with TanStack Query, Zustand, Playwright, Detox and Jest. Around 95% of our code is reused across web and mobile.

About the role

Senior Frontend Engineers work across our product domains. Your team match will reflect your strengths, interests and where you can contribute most.

Across every team, the model is the same: small, autonomous groups, a weekly release cycle and ownership from problem definition through production.

What you’ll do

  • Own complex frontend features end to end across web and mobile.

  • Design and evolve React and React Native systems, shared libraries and durable abstractions.

  • Identify and resolve rendering, state-management, bundle and runtime-performance bottlenecks.

  • Use TypeScript to make behaviour explicit and prevent defects rather than suppressing type errors.

  • Work closely with product, backend engineering and QA to turn complex requirements into simple user experiences.

  • Keep quality high through code review, unit, end-to-end and visual-regression testing.

  • Share knowledge, mentor colleagues and raise the frontend engineering standard.

What you need to have

  • Proven ownership of production frontend systems built with React or React Native and TypeScript.

  • Strong knowledge of React rendering, component boundaries, data flow and state management.

  • A track record of designing maintainable frontend architecture and reusable abstractions.

  • Practical experience diagnosing performance problems in complex web or mobile products.

  • Sound testing judgement across unit, end-to-end and visual-regression coverage.

  • Clear, structured problem-solving and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals, product judgement and confidence learning unfamiliar technologies.

Depth in one frontend ecosystem and sound tool choice matter more than familiarity with every technology listed.

What to expect

  • Recruiter conversation

  • Code Review

  • Experience Deep Dive

  • Managerial interview

Your recruiter will explain each stage clearly and follow up after every conversation.

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!
